paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Number of tasks by language family.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of tasks completed by multilingual BERT models for various language families. The horizontal axis, labeled “Language Family,” displays the categories in alphabetical order: IE-Indic, IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Other, IE-Slavic, Basque, Turkic, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled “# tasks,” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick intervals of 10.  The bars represent the number of tasks completed for each language family, with the IE-Slavic bar being the tallest, reaching a value of approximately 52, followed by IE-Romance with a value of approximately 42.  The IE-Germanic bar has a value of approximately 33, while the IE-Baltic bar has a value of approximately 20. The IE-Indic bar represents a value of approximately 10, the IE-Other, Basque, Turkic, Semitic, and Uralic bars each represent a value of approximately 4.  The bars are presented in alphabetical order by language family and are not visually emphasized.
